neighbours.label: answerability relation: 'to' (and 'directly') after reports / is responsible / answerable, naming the superior
fire: In this ministry the chief auditor reports directly to the prime minister.
Each regional manager reports to the national sales director.
The emperor was accountable to no one but heaven itself.
The inspector general is answerable to parliament, not to the cabinet.
Under the charter, the governor was responsible to the king alone.
Every site supervisor reports to the head of operations each week.
The intelligence unit reports directly to the president's office.
The new ethics board is answerable to the shareholders.
quiet: In this ministry the chief auditor writes a yearly report on spending.
Each regional manager travels often to visit important customers.
The emperor was admired by many people across the provinces.
The inspector general visited parliament to give a short speech.
Under the charter, the governor collected taxes from the towns.
Every site supervisor checks the safety equipment each week.
The intelligence unit moved into a new building last spring.
The new ethics board meets four times a year.
